title: When You Finish Work at 4:59 PM
description: Home office, 4:59 PM. Doug takes off his headset, picks up a pen, says "Mamba out." and mic-drops it. The clock hits 4:59:59 and BOSS calls. He freezes, looks screen, pen, screen, picks the pen back up, puts it back, puts the headset back on: UNMAMBA. "...Alright." The cursor drifts toward Accept and stops; he stares into the webcam; cut to black.

versions.notes: First cut: 14.7 s. Mamba out → 4:59:59 BOSS call → UNMAMBA. → stare and cut to black.
